answer: Ambient Beacon Quorum**: each agent identity must be co-located with a physical node that continuously emits a signed radio beacon bounded to a surveyed geographic cell; peers verify beacon continuity and cross-check timing against a karst terrain map to reject replayed or simulated signals. A raven protocol auditor periodically challenges nodes to prove live sensor correlation. Registering a new identity requires a fresh node deployed at a bridge-accessible site with independent power.
